message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **national public holidays** that create “long weekends” in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(If you’re planning trips that cross provincial borders, keep in mind that some holidays—e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks’ Day, etc.—are only observed in specific provinces; the dates listed here are the ones that apply nationwide.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span (including the holiday) | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------------------------------|-------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | **Mon** | Jan 1 – 3 (Mon – Wed) | National holiday. |
| **February 20** | Family Day (observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) | **Mon** | Feb 20 – 22 (Mon – Wed) | Not a national holiday, but creates a long weekend in the provinces that observe it. |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | **Fri** | Apr 7 – 9 (Fri – Sun) | National holiday. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | **Mon** | May 22 – 24 (Mon – Wed) | National holiday. |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | **Sat** | Jul 1 – 3 (Sat – Mon) | National holiday. Observed on Monday July 3 because the actual day falls on Saturday. |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | **Mon** | Sep 4 – 6 (Mon – Wed) | National holiday. |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | **Mon** | Oct 9 – 11 (Mon – Wed) | National holiday. |
| **November 11** | Remembrance Day (observed on Monday November 13 in 2023) | **Thu** | Nov 11 – 13 (Thu – Sat) | National holiday. Observed on Monday Nov 13. |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | **Mon** | Dec 25 – 27 (Mon – Wed) | National holiday. |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | **Tue** | Dec 26 – 28 (Tue – Thu) | National holiday, but does not create a long weekend unless you take the preceding Friday off. |

### How to Use This List

1. **Plan around the national holidays** – These dates will give you guaranteed long weekends across the country.
2. **Check provincial calendars** – If you’re traveling within a particular province, add the provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks’ Day, etc.) to your list.
3. **Adjust for observed days** – Some holidays that fall on a weekend are officially observed on the following Monday (Canada Day, Remembrance Day). Make sure your app reflects the observed date if you’re counting days off.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown for a specific province or if you need the data in a particular format (CSV, JSON, etc.).
